caption: The drawing features a single central object that resembles a metallic branding iron or a similarly shaped implement. The object is composed of two vertical, parallel bars connected at the top and bottom by a backward-curving semicircular segment on the left, forming a shape similar to a reversed "B" fused with an "H". A straight, pointed rod extends diagonally to the right from the middle of the object, giving it a distinctive profile. The object is depicted in shades of brown and gray, with darker accents suggesting rust or aged metal. The background is a light, off-white or beige color, with some visible stains and marks. At the bottom right corner of the paper, the name "Alfonso Moreno" and the year "1938" are handwritten in small, neat script.
title: Branding Iron
